backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles and per-user file lists with permission checks using AccessControl.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old user profile and transaction structures to new profiles and empty file lists.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs for project evidence tracking.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Mapping of frontend source file paths to short descriptions summarizing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/.env.example: Template defining optional Vite environment variables for public app URL and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/delivery/DEPLOY_TROUBLESHOOTING: Guide describing common deployment issues and fixes for stable frontend builds on the Internet Computer.
frontend/delivery/PROJECT_TREE.md: Document outlining the full project folder structure for the Payment Tracker App.
frontend/delivery/README.md: Overview of the delivery package explaining included files, purpose, and how to regenerate the export.
frontend/delivery/regenerate-export.sh: Script that regenerates the delivery export by copying key files and updating metadata.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining color variables and theming for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, favicon, and mounting point for the React application.
frontend/README.md: Frontend documentation covering setup, prerequisites, and development workflow for the app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication, profile setup flow, and rendering the main layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen using Internet Identity with feature previews and a button that triggers authentication.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for collecting and saving a user’s name during initial profile setup.
frontend/src/components/charts/IncomeVsE: Bar chart comparing monthly income and expenses using fetched totals.
frontend/src/components/disclosures/Manu: Info box explaining that all transactions are manually entered and not bank-connected.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout managing navigation, header, logout flow, and monthly reminder banner.
frontend/src/components/month/MonthPicke: Month navigation control allowing users to switch between months and years.
frontend/src/components/notifications/Mo: Banner notifying users of a new month with actions to view summary or dismiss.
frontend/src/components/summary/MonthlyT: Card displaying monthly totals for received, sent, and balance values.
frontend/src/components/transactions/Tra: Form component that validates input and adds a new transaction via useAddTransaction, then triggers success or error actions.
Fetches and displays monthly transactions with loading, error, empty states, and formatted income/expense entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to fetch and save the caller’s user profile through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication flow, storing identity, managing login state, and exposing login/clear actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useMonthlyReminder.ts: Tracks per-user monthly reminders using localStorage and exposes functions to toggle, acknowledge, and check reminder state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating where feature-specific query hooks are organized.
frontend/src/hooks/useSelectedMonth.ts: Stores and persists the user’s selected month and year in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useTransactions.ts: Manages localStorage-backed transaction CRUD for the authenticated user and exposes queries for monthly data and totals.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and sets light/dark theme OKLCH color variables and base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, importing global CSS.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Renders settings UI including profile info, notifications toggle, app link copying, and disclosures.
frontend/src/pages/SummaryPage.tsx: Displays a monthly financial summary with totals, balance highlight, charts, and month acknowledgment logic.
frontend/src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx: Shows month picker, totals, chart preview, transaction form toggle, and list of transactions.
frontend/src/types/transaction.ts: Defines local transaction types, enums, and monthly totals interfaces.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Provides a clipboard copy utility with modern API and legacy fallback.
frontend/src/utils/getPublicAppUrl.ts: Returns the public app URL using an environment variable or the current origin.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Declares Vite environment variable types for build-time configuration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, color mappings, plugins, and dark mode settings.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, existing features, new feature requests, and metadata for the Payment Tracker App build and delivery process.
